assessment: This manuscript presents an important contribution to the field of single-cell transcriptomic analysis in cancer by introducing a novel computational framework-SCellBOW-which applies embedding techniques from natural language processing to model phenotypic heterogeneity in tumors. The revised version includes new validation experiments and significant clarifications that provide convincing evidence for the method's utility. The authors have benchmarked SCellBOW across diverse datasets, including glioblastoma, breast, and metastatic prostate cancer, and have demonstrated its superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.
